findings.summary: Susan Clark, established as the firm's physician-compensation and fair-market-value specialist, does not appear on the one engagement that is a Physician Compensation Review; it is led instead by the service-line economist Daniel Alvarado with analyst Patricia Moore.
findings.evidence: d:0002 introduces Susan Clark as the Principal who 'will take up any question that touches physician compensation, and she is careful with fair-market-value language,' and in d:0009 she completes the 2020 FMV review and flags an arrangement. But the 2021 Physician Compensation Review names her nowhere: d:0010 has 'Daniel Alvarado, a senior consultant who spends his working life in the economics of clinical service lines, will lead the compensation analysis,' and the team in d:0011/d:0013 is only Daniel and Patricia. No document contradicts a stated fact, so this reads as a defensible staffing choice rather than a continuity break; recorded as an observation, not a defect.
